messages:
Kamal: infra-bot flagged a HIGH severity finding in an image we pushed — CVE-2026-12345 (libssl). Image: redwood/runtime:2026-03-18, layer sha256:abcd1234...
infra-bot: [automated] image-scan result: severity=HIGH, cves=[CVE-2026-12345], sbom_mismatch=true, scanner=clair-v4
Talia: @Samir can you pause the canary? this looks like a prod image.
Samir: pausing canary now. marking the image as quarantined and blocking promotions.
Elaine: any idea if this came from the base image or our package set?
Kamal: quick lookup of the SBOM shows openssl 1.1.1k from ubuntu:22.04 base. Build pulled base on 2026-03-10 (digest pinned in logs).
Samir: Immediate containment plan: 1) Prevent new deploys of that tag 2) Quarantine the image in registry 3) Rebuild against patched base 4) Create incident ticket and notify SRE/security 5) Short-term RBAC restriction on promotions
Talia: I'll open SEC-4123 and assign eng-runtime + eng-sre. adding checklist.
Kamal: running quarantine command now: ```gcloud artifacts docker images add-tag gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:abcd1234 gcr.io/redwood/quarantine/runtime:1799443210 --quiet```
Samir: also applying an Artifact Registry deny rule to stop CI from promoting the quarantined digest.
Talia: we should also enable extended audit logging for KMS sign operations and artifact promotions while we triage.
Elaine: agree — RBAC change: restrict image-promotion to a small oncall group until we rebuild. I'll submit the change to the RBAC policy and request expedited review.
Samir: @security-bot can you surface KMS signing events for the image signing key over the last 30 days? want to rule out key compromise.
security-bot: query complete — KMS_SIGN events for key projects/redwood/kms/images: 12 events in last 30 days, all from known CI service accounts. no anomalous geo or IP. audit logs retained for 90d.
infra-bot: additional scans: builds triggered by release pipeline between 2026-03-10 and 2026-03-18 scanned, 1 vulnerable image found (this one). older digests scanned clean.
Kamal: good to know. Post-incident actions: - Update SBOM generation to include base image digest and set policy to fail CI on critical base-image CVEs - Add automated alert for sbom_mismatch=true - Add manual review step for promotion if image was patched within 7 days
Talia: adding those to SEC-4123 action list and owners.
Elaine: we should also consider rotating CI service-account keys that can promote images; I'll include that in the ticket and coordinate with IAM.
Samir: re-signing workflow: we'll rebuild with patched base (ubuntu:22.04 patched openssl) and re-sign using our KMS key, then run full scan. ETA for rebuild + CI: ~3 hours.
Kamal: I'll trigger the rebuild and post the new digest here once done.
Talia: customer comms: not public yet. I'll draft an internal comms note for SOC and customer success in case any Dedicated/private customers used that image.
Samir: thanks — assigning follow-ups. thumbs up when you have the new digest and scan results.
Kamal: new image built and scanned: redwood/runtime:2026-03-18-patched sha256:efgh5678; scanner reports no high CVEs. pushing to promote once SEC-4123 owners OK.
Elaine: RBAC rollback plan in SEC-4123: remove temporary restriction after one successful promotion and 48h of clean scans.
Talia: closing loop in ticket, adding retrospective action items for SBOM and signing audit.
Samir: great work team, we'll keep monitoring. :thumbsup:
